intent: Generate new original game material tiles; convert to 512x512 RGB JPEG for the existing BMD texture contract.
golden: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable diffuse/albedo game armor texture, square 1024x1024, one flat texture filling the entire image. Primary request: richly yellow polished royal gold armor metal in the classic MU Online Golden monster visual language, not brown or beige or chalky. Most of the surface is clean smooth amber-yellow metal with restrained fine engraved interlocking feather-like scrollwork, shallow cut grooves dark ochre and thin bright yellow cut edges, visually readable at 512px. Color family: saturated warm gold #D79718 through #F4BD32 with dark recesses #77500A, no pure white. Neutral broad illumination, no spotlight, no bloom, no emissive glow, no cast shadows. Front-on flat orthographic material tile, seamless repeat at boundaries, no bevel/frame around the tile. This is a usable texture mapped over already modeled plates and ornamental blades, not an illustration of an armor suit: no people, no weapons, no gems, no layout panels, no text, no watermark. Avoid cloudy noise, dirt, grunge, giant dominant ornaments and a metallic wall made of separate bricks. Return ONLY the flat square metal texture.
steel: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable diffuse/albedo game armor texture, square 1024x1024, one flat texture filling the entire image. Primary request: clean cool neutral metallic gray steel, similar to polished medieval armor in MU Online Dark Iron Knight. Steel gray, absolutely no ivory/cream/white/gold. Smooth medium-gray metal #68727C and darker gray micro-recesses #343C46, restrained fine chased featherlike curving lines with lighter silver edges #A3AFB8; only slight tightly brushed grain. A subtle repeatable engraved texture suitable on narrow raised filigree trims of an existing 3D armor model. Neutral illumination; DO NOT bake white flares or strong environmental reflections (the game adds specular reflections dynamically). Front-on flat orthographic material tile, seamless edges, no perimeter frame, no bevel border. No people, no armor suit, no objects, no gems, no text, no watermark. Avoid stone, concrete, leather, cloudy noise, black patches, glitter, over-dense ornament. Return ONLY the flat square steel texture.
compatibility: Celestial_Ivory.jpg keeps its existing resource identifier but now contains gray steel; no BMD names or UVs change.
